description: This PHP source file defines the class CalendarSyncOperationSerializer, which handles serialization and deserialization of CalendarSyncOperation objects to and from JSON strings. It includes methods to convert objects into JSON representations and parse JSON data back into objects, with validation and error handling. The class relies on other domain entities such as CalendarAccountEvent, CalendarSyncOperation, and enums CalendarLocation and CalendarSyncAction, as well as a CalendarEventSerializer for nested event serialization.

classes.name: CalendarSyncOperationSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class responsible for converting CalendarSyncOperation objects to JSON strings and vice versa, ensuring data integrity and proper validation.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a CalendarSyncOperation object into a JSON string representation, including nested payload serialization.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a JSON string back into a CalendarSyncOperation object with validation and error handling.
